prompt_sets.role: Exact front/back hair extraction and hidden posterior hair completion prompts
Exact feature extraction prompts and eye retry provenance; nose/mouth candidates are archived only

unchanged_basis: Existing approved male head/skin and seven paired clothing choices; existing male01 choices remain available.
registration: One shared whole-group similarity based on the two pupil positions and chin. Native eye extraction is first returned to approved-source coordinates; combined mapping is sampled once. No local feature warps or runtime offsets.
limitations: Source-visible pigment is conserved where supported by the native alpha. Hidden regions and removed crossing hairs require generated completion. Reused nose/mouth and fixed head mean the actual combination is not claimed to be pixel-identical to the whole portrait.
